about: The Workbench icons of the MirrorMagic drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is upstream's graphics/gfx_mirrormagic/icons/icon.png. MirrorMagic-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, MirrorMagic.info beside the program. ReadMe.info is also copied for the licence and the credits; Folder.info for the data drawers.
